title: Austin City Council Tax & Street Work Decisions
summary:
• **Tax relief approved** — The council granted several property owners' petitions to reduce their tax assessments, including decisions favoring O. Del Curto and A.F. Rauch, while denying S.J. Kingsbury's request.

• **Street improvement funding cut** — Aldermen approved $300 (reduced from $500) for extra labor and materials for street work, with one council member dissenting.

• **Property redemption rights expanded** — A new ordinance allowed property owners to reclaim properties the city had purchased at tax foreclosure sales under specific conditions.

• **Multiple tax appeals postponed** — Nine individuals and businesses, including the Scottish American Mortgage Company, filed appeals against the Board of Equalization's property valuations, which were tabled for later consideration.
